text:
Predicates:
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Premieres(z, y) ::: z premiered y.
Orchestra(z) ::: z is an orchestra.
Leads(x, z) ::: x leads z.
Conducts(z) ::: z is a conductor.
Ensemble(z) ::: z is an ensemble.
SpecializesIn(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphony9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
Wrote(beethoven, symphony9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premieres(viennaMusicSociety, symphony9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(z) → ∃x (Conductor(x) ∧ Leads(x, z)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
